This component adapts evidence-handling prompt principles from HolmesGPT.
Source: https://github.com/HolmesGPT/holmesgpt
Pinned revision: 49804bde566633d4e945952e01c6bf99df6df7ab
Source file: holmes/plugins/prompts/generic_ask.jinja2
License: Apache License 2.0, included in LICENSE-HolmesGPT.txt.

Modifications: selected principles were translated and adapted for Chinese
business-query failure explanations: distinguish observed facts from hypotheses;
correlate actual error evidence rather than coincident events; constrain impact
claims to observed entities. No HolmesGPT executable runtime is bundled.
The remaining request isolation, redaction, model client and API adapter are
implemented for this project. This notice was created for the adaptation;
the source repository had no root NOTICE file at the pinned revision.
